name: dl_uart_rx_path
description: Stream0 UART receive framing, actual SRAM storage and firmware-read credit accounting.

behavior: - Module `dl_uart_rx_path`, parameter `C_RX_DEPTH=128`, valid research range1..4095; storage width32. One clock and synchronous low reset. No raw gated clocks, functions/tasks, or undocumented CDC.

- Inputs: `i_clk`, `i_rstn`, `i_stream_reset`, `i_channel4_enabled`, `i_word_valid`, `i_word[31:0]`, `i_fw_ready`. The local stream reset is held by the future reset sequencer. It flushes storage/counters and suppresses data errors; it does not substitute for40NoOp/10ms exchange.

- Ingress has no ready. The trusted front end removes failed/duplicate flits and supplies ordered uncompressed32-bit messages. Idle decoding uses mclass5:2/mtype8:6. UART transport length is31:27+1. Stream0 is11:9=0. Reserved header bits are ignored per§2.4; no compressed-wire decoder is implemented here.

- A transport header never enters SRAM. Subsequent valid words are opaque payload until the original count expires, including words that look like credit/reset/other headers. Invalid cycles do not decrement the count. Headers for unallocated streams still establish run-out length and discard payload.

- At a stream0 header, admit only after initialization, while Channel4 is enabled and stream reset is inactive, with at least the complete payload length of pre-edge FIFO free capacity. A simultaneous firmware read does not supply admission capacity. Insufficient capacity reports a local overflow diagnostic and discards the whole transport. This is local handling of traffic violating the credited capacity, not a standard wire error encoding.

- During an admitted message, an offline/reset interval latches discard through the original end, even if no word arrives during that interval. Already stored payload can be read offline; stream reset explicitly flushes it. An unexpected storage-not-ready condition drops the current/remainder and reports a local error only while enabled and out of reset.

- Global reset clears framing and all local ownership. Stream reset flushes FIFO and Receiver Credit Counter but preserves framing run-out. On the first released edge initialize the counter to actual depth; no data admission/read on that edge. Thereafter increment modulo4096 only on a real firmware valid/ready read. Do not return credits on arrival, prefetch, header reception or empty reads.

- Expose firmware valid/data, total RX fill12, initialized/credit snapshot12, framing remaining6/drop, actual payload write/discard, header and message-done events, local error. Invalid firmware data is zero.

- At a header boundary, decode stream0 Credit Update DataFCSeq31:20 while initialized/out of stream reset, including Channel4 offline. Decode Reset Request/Response for stream0 or allStreams12 even while stream reset is held; expose allStreams and response Status15:13. Do not autonomously reset on these events. Other nontransport words are forwarded unchanged to the higher DL dispatcher. Payload never leaks into those events. Incoming decode does not implement outgoing credit cadence or reset FSM.

- All events are pre-edge combinational qualifications. Reset masks all public outputs. FIFO/model masks must match synchronous release semantics and current held reset; no hidden clock latency is assumed at the interface.
limitations: Ingress CRC/replay and compressed-wire decoding are upstream.
Outgoing Credit Update cadence A20/UCR01 and full40NoOp/10ms Stream Reset controller remain separate.
Depths other than128 are research configurations; physical closure must be measured separately.
